representation: Derived incident finding joined to retained original service source, journal and control-plane observation.
mechanism: The pre-existing drop-in took effect at service start after reboot; standby held runner.lock and refreshed local readiness while never authenticating or polling the remote queue. The previously running real process masked the dormant override in a manual already-active test.
helper_behavior: One restore(config) call; with keep_alive enabled it entered an unconditional sleep loop even after caught startup failure.
dashboard_offline_indicator: Correct; not hidden or weakened by repair.
historical_limits: Task Scheduler Operational history was disabled.
Missing historical events were not reconstructed as if captured.

failed_boot_windows.meaning: 0x41301: running, not completed platform readiness. Startup happened on the original failed boot.
failed_boot_windows.inference: The helper observed native Docker before Desktop launched; Desktop was not the enrolled engine dependency.
